title: fix(plugin-detail): a record on a print page prints its own title field (objectui#12787)
body:
Fixes #12787
Clause-②: no

## What

On a page that declares `print`, `record:details` now prints the record's own title field. A printed invoice carries its invoice number again. Off a print page nothing changes.

Off a print page, `record:details` hides the row that the page header's H1 already shows: the declared name field, else the field a `titleFormat` resolves to, else the first title candidate that has a value. A print page refuses `page:header`, so on paper nothing drew that value.

`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx` now reads `usePrintPage() !== null` with its other hooks, above every early return, the same way `DetailView` (PR #12785) and `DetailSection` (PR #12729) read it. On a print page the whole title ladder is skipped. An author's `hideFields` and the `record:highlights` dedupe still apply: their premise does not depend on a page header.

No prop, type member, export or i18n key changed.

## Measured

- Before the fix, a test with each rung on a print page showed all three rungs drop the row: the declared name field, the `titleFormat` match and the candidate fallback.
- `showcase_invoice` (next.2) declares no `nameField` and no `titleFormat`. On the live PDF, the invoice number was hidden by the candidate fallback (the derived `name`), not by the declared-name branch.

## Tests

New `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/record-details.printTitleField-12787.test.tsx`, through the real renderer:

- Inside a `PrintPageProvider`, the title row prints for a declared name field (INV-1010), for a `titleFormat` that resolves to `contract_no`, and for the candidate fallback.
- CONTROL: off a print page, the same three rows stay hidden.
- The objectui#10360 and objectui#9436 dedupe pins are unchanged and green (14 passed with the new file).

Ablations, with the fix committed:

- The print guard forced off turns the three print rows red and leaves the controls green.
- The guard forced on turns the three controls red.
- Both were restored to HEAD (blob equal, `git diff HEAD` empty).

Results at `05aab42`:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail test` (run at `1eb4c26`, before a type-only follow-up to the new test): 282 files passed, 1 skipped; 2692 tests passed, 18 skipped.
- The new file at `05aab42`: 6 passed.
- Exit 0: the plugin-detail closure build, `type-check`, `build`, tsc over the package's test config, eslint on the touched files (no new warnings), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, the changeset presence check, `check:new-line-citations` and `check:test-path-roots`.

## Printed page

Setup:

- Published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2` showcase backend, from the showcase source at the next.2 release commit.
- A throwaway A4 `print` page on `showcase_invoice` whose `record:details` declares `name`, added in a scratch copy only.
- INV-1010 printed to PDF with Chromium, on the record route and on the named page route.

PDF text read at capture:

- Before (main `f114263`), record route: no INV-1010.
- Before, named page route: no INV-1010.
- After, record route: INVOICE NUMBER INV-1010.
- After, named page route: INVOICE NUMBER INV-1010.

Screenshots:

- Before, record route: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/f9af05bebdb786be2c0c7df54928bdbb08ef8d85/docs/design/findings/12787/before-record-pdf-1.png?raw=true
- Before, named page route: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/f9af05bebdb786be2c0c7df54928bdbb08ef8d85/docs/design/findings/12787/before-named-pdf-1.png?raw=true
- After, record route: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/f9af05bebdb786be2c0c7df54928bdbb08ef8d85/docs/design/findings/12787/after-record-pdf-1.png?raw=true
- After, named page route: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/f9af05bebdb786be2c0c7df54928bdbb08ef8d85/docs/design/findings/12787/after-named-pdf-1.png?raw=true
- CONTROL, the ordinary record page after the change (light): the H1 reads INV-1010 and no Invoice Number row appears below it. https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/f9af05bebdb786be2c0c7df54928bdbb08ef8d85/docs/design/findings/12787/after-control-ordinary-record-page.png?raw=true

The images live on branch `claude/issue-12787-evidence` only. This branch carries no PNG or PDF.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, unchanged: `page:header`'s refusal on a print page (the spec's contract), `DetailView`'s own header and the auto-tabs strip on a print page, and the related list (objectui#12741).
- The test file sits in `src/__tests__/`, where the claim's file surface names it. The sibling title-dedupe pins live in `src/renderers/__tests__/`.
